subject: Daylight Full-Loop: Panel Rotation + Respite Windows
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Recruiting Operations <recruiting-ops@talentpartners.io>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Daylight Full-Loop: Panel Rotation + Respite Windows

Hi team,

We need to finalize the virtual onsite for Asha (SWE, backend) the week of 22 Jul. Recruit Ops proposed two candidate-visible days; I want to try a single-day condensed full loop with three break windows we can promise the candidate. High level ask:

- Panel sequencing to avoid subject overlap (infra, API, systems).
- Two simultaneous interviewer tracks for 40m deep dives and one 25m system design block.
- A 45m respite (lunch) and two 20m micro-respite windows staggered so interviewers can swap.
- Clear debrief owner per interviewer group, to submit evals within 90 minutes of loop close.

Attached is a quick itinerary and a panel-rotation CSV with proposed pairings. Can you review and flag any conflicts by EOD? If all good, Recruiting Ops will publish the invite and prep materials for Asha.

Quick notes: candidate prefers Pacific daylight hours (no earlier than 10am PDT) and asked for a 30m buffer before panel start.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Tech Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-fullloop-itinerary.pdf (1.2MB), panel-rotation-grid.csv (4KB)

On Mon, Jul 14, 2025 at 09:12, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We need to finalize the virtual onsite for Asha (SWE, backend) the week of 22 Jul.
> Attached is a quick itinerary and a panel-rotation CSV with proposed pairings.

Thanks for the outline — this looks sensible. A couple of tweaks from an interviewer-capacity perspective:

- Move the 25m system-design to immediately after the first 40m track — gives context and reduces repeated onboarding for the same domain.
- Swap one infra interviewer out of the second 40m (they're scheduled on-call that afternoon). Karthik, can you provide an alternative infra lead?
- Recommend the first micro-respite be 25m (morning caffeine buffer) so we don't crush the midday 45m lunch when panel overruns happen.

I'll own debrief collection for Track A (API + infra). If Karthik can take Track B (systems + design), that splits the work cleanly.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Eng Hiring, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Thanks — I can take Track B debriefs. For the infra swap: use Jonas Weber as the drop-in; he's done this domain and is available the 22nd (I've checked with him).

Two practical comments on the itinerary:

- Please add a 10m candidate preflight at candidate-local 10:00 (to cover mic/test + expectations). I suggest we set the loop start at 10:30 PDT.
- For the 45m lunch, please block it explicitly in the interviewer invites and mark it \"Do not move\" — we should avoid back-to-back interview drift.

If Recruiting Ops can send the calendar once the times are locked, I'll message Jonas and the other swap-in.

Karthik
